name: TherapyAppointment
short_description: US mental-health EHR with scheduling, notes, insurance claims, client portal and optional DoseSpot e-prescribing, priced by monthly session volume.
long_description: TherapyAppointment is a US practice-management system for mental-health clinicians, started in the late 1990s by a psychologist. Pricing is tiered by booked sessions: $10/month until a practice books more than 10 sessions, $39/month up to 39 sessions, then $59/month. Tiers do not step back down automatically. Scheduling, client portal, secure messaging, reminders, ERA posting and intake with e-signatures are included. Electronic claims (15¢ each, paid to Office Ally), integrated telehealth ($15/month per provider), AI notes (59¢ per note) and e-prescribing through DoseSpot, including controlled substances ($65/month per prescriber plus a $110 setup fee), are add-ons.
one_liner: Low-cost US therapy EHR that grows with your caseload, with e-prescribing available as an add-on.
best_for: New or part-time US practices: $10/month until you book more than 10 sessions
Therapists who bill insurance themselves and want claims and ERA posting built in
Therapy practices adding a prescriber, via DoseSpot e-prescribing with EPCS ($65/month per prescriber)
Clinicians who want month-to-month terms with no contract
not_for: Practices that want one all-inclusive price: telehealth, AI notes, claims and e-prescribing cost extra
Teams that need SOC 2 or HITRUST reports from the EHR vendor itself

notes.low-volume: $10/month until you book more than 10 sessions, then $39 and $59 tiers; month-to-month with a 30-day trial.
notes.budget: One of the lowest entry prices for a full US therapy EHR, with claims at 15¢ each and ERA posting free.
notes.insurance-billing: Claims, eligibility lookups (7¢ each), ERA auto-posting and claim tracking are built in.
notes.prescriber: A therapy-first EHR where adding a prescriber is a $65/month DoseSpot add-on with EPCS, not a switch to a psychiatry system.

seo.meta_description: TherapyAppointment is an affordable EHR for therapists and counselors with scheduling, notes, billing, and telehealth starting at $39/month.

faqs.a: TherapyAppointment pricing starts at approximately $39-$49 per month for individual practitioners. Group practice pricing scales per provider. A 30-day free trial is available with no long-term contract required.

No, TherapyAppointment does not include e-prescribing functionality. It is designed for non-prescribing therapists and counselors. Psychiatrists should consider alternatives with e-prescribing capabilities.
Yes, TherapyAppointment is HIPAA compliant with BAA available. The platform includes secure data handling and HIPAA-compliant telehealth.
TherapyAppointment is best for solo therapists and small counseling practices seeking an affordable, straightforward practice management solution without complex features or high costs.
